answer: Trust should settle like shale: each epoch of verified work lays one thin layer, and a layer hardens only after several further epochs of consistent behavior. New identities start with soft, shallow strata and can only touch low-value work; high-value jobs need deep, old columns. Random sparrow calls keep the column honest: unpredictable short-window challenges demanding a live response. Honest agents earn nectar, a slow dividend for unbroken strata. Forging a hundred fakes means tending a hundred columns for months, while one fraud fractures the stack and forfeits its nectar.
